tools.name: query_graph
tools.description: Search the knowledge graph using BFS or DFS. Returns relevant nodes and edges as text context.

question.description: Natural language question or keyword search

mode.description: bfs=broad context, dfs=trace a specific path

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get full details for a specific node by label or ID.

label.description: Node label or ID to look up

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: get_neighbors
tools.description: Get all direct neighbors of a node with edge details.

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: get_community
tools.description: Get all nodes in a community by community ID.

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: god_nodes
tools.description: Return the most connected nodes - the core abstractions of the knowledge graph.

exclude_hubs_percentile.description: Suppress nodes whose degree exceeds this percentile (0-100) of the degree distribution, matching cluster()'s hub exclusion

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: graph_stats
tools.description: Return summary statistics: node count, edge count, communities, confidence breakdown.

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: shortest_path
tools.description: Find the shortest path between two concepts in the knowledge graph. Follows stored edge direction by default; set undirected=true to ignore it.

undirected.description: Ignore stored edge direction when searching

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: list_prs
tools.description: List open GitHub PRs with CI status, review state, and graph impact (which communities each PR touches, blast radius). Use this before starting work to check if a PR already covers the area you're about to change.

base.description: Base branch to filter PRs by (auto-detected if omitted)

repo.description: GitHub repo (owner/repo). Defaults to current repo.

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: get_pr_impact
tools.description: Get detailed graph impact for a specific PR: which files it changes, which knowledge-graph communities are affected, and how many nodes are touched. Use this to assess merge risk or check for overlap with your current work.

repo.description: GitHub repo (owner/repo). Defaults to current repo.

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.

tools.name: triage_prs
tools.description: Return all actionable open PRs (correct base, not stale) with full graph impact data so you can reason about review priority, merge order, and conflict risk. Call this when the user asks 'what PRs should I review?' or 'what's ready to merge?'

base.description: Base branch to filter PRs by (auto-detected if omitted)

repo.description: GitHub repo (owner/repo). Defaults to current repo.

project_path.description: Absolute path to a project directory containing .graphicle/graph.json. Optional — defaults to the graph this server was started with.
